text.trigger: A survivor finishes a search at the Hospital.
text.vignette: In a corner of the hospital activity room waits a karaoke machine, a crate of board games and three working car batteries. It is enough to put on a real party for the colony, if you do not mind the noise.

options.throw-party: Haul it home and hold the party: morale rises by 1, but the racket draws 5 zombies to the colony.
options.skip-it: Decide it is a bad idea and keep searching. Nothing happens.
